description: Coldwater's answer to policing, housed in a concrete box with the windows bricked in to sill height and a camera on every corner, three of which turn. The blue lamp over the door still works. Behind mesh, a noticeboard carries a dozen curled sheets under the heading PERSONS OF INTEREST, sun-bleached down to the outlines of faces. Somebody has pinned a takeaway menu up among them. The lobby is west; Kessler Street runs east.
name: Precinct 9
